gloss: to tell a lie; to lie

definitions.gloss: to tell a lie; to lie; to say something untrue
definitions.explanation: The standard expression for telling a deliberate falsehood. Uses the verb つく in the sense of uttering or producing.

examples.japanese: {嘘|うそ}をついて⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{嘘|うそ}をついて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦に{違|ちが}いない→に違いない：18584_nichigainai⟧。
{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{嘘|うそ}をついて⟦{叱|しか}られた→叱る：01202_shikaru⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I often got scolded for telling lies.

examples.japanese: {嘘|うそ}をつく⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}す→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Telling a lie is easy, but regaining trust is difficult.

notes:
The most basic and common way to say "to lie" in Japanese. The verb つく here is a godan verb meaning "to utter" (different from ⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ "to attach" or ⟦{着|つ}く→着く：00680_tsuku⟧ "to arrive"). The expression is a fixed collocation — ⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧ always takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ and つく in this meaning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {嘘|うそ}をつく: to tell a lie
- {嘘|うそ}をつき⟦{通|とお}す→通す：02300_toosu⟧: to keep lying, to maintain a lie
- {大|おお}{嘘|うそ}をつく: to tell a big lie
- ⟦{嘘|うそ}つき→嘘つき：08273_usotsuki⟧: liar (noun)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{方便|ほうべん}: the end justifies the means (proverb — even lies can be expedient)
- ⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧⟦みたい→みたい：10755_mitai⟧: unbelievable, too good to be true
- ⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧でしょ: you're kidding, no way
